source.test: D-027 section -- staged-upload translation of Tier 3

expected.reason: The single-remaining-fallback tolerance carries over: if a pending pack-import operation has exactly one outstanding blocked file and the client uploads exactly one file against it, the upload is accepted even on a total filename mismatch -- mirroring Tier 3's reasoning that a browser-saved name can bear no resemblance to the CurseForge API's recorded name at all.

notes: Unlike MSC 1's folder-watch fallback, this operates over a single-purpose staged-upload slot already bound to one specific pending file at creation time (per the note below on purpose-binding) -- so 'exactly one file' here means the redemption call itself, not a scan across an entire ambiguous folder.
